name: Insidepost Autoposting for vkontakt
author: n8ninside

sections.description:
Insidepost Autoposting for vkontakt sends a WordPress post to a vkontakt wall. Publish in WordPress, and the plugin creates the wall post in a community or on a user profile. vkontakt is a third-party service. This plugin is not affiliated with it.

  • Autopost when a post is first published.
  • Manual send from the editor and from the posts list.
  • Text from the main content or the excerpt, with an optional word limit.
  • Image from the featured image, an attachment, or the first local image in the content.
  • A log of API responses.
  • Optional extras: WooCommerce price and product tags, post tags, and a shared closing paragraph.

Setup

  1. Create a vkontakt standalone application and paste its numeric ID.
  2. Get a token with the wall, photos, and offline permissions.
  3. Enter a community ID with a leading minus sign, or a user ID.
  4. Choose post types and turn on autoposting, or send posts manually.

External services

This plugin connects to vkontakt only after a site administrator saves an application access token. No external request is made before that.

  • Service: vkontakt API, https://dev.vk.com/
  • When: on the first publish of a selected post if autoposting is enabled, or when an editor clicks “Send to vkontakt”.
  • Data sent: post title, post text, permalink, an image file from the media library when one is found, the community or user ID, and the access token.
  • Destination: https://api.vk.com and the photo upload URL returned by vkontakt. Those hosts are vk.com, vkontakte.ru, userapi.com, vkuser.net, or vk-cdn.net.
  • Terms of use: https://vk.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://vk.com/privacy

If a proxy is saved in the plugin settings, the same requests are sent through that proxy. The site administrator provides the proxy. The plugin does not supply one.

The Composer class loader in vendor/composer is third-party code under the MIT license, which is compatible with the GPL. Its license text is in vendor/composer/LICENSE.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the insidepost-autoposting-for-vkontakt folder to /wp-content/plugins.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Open Settings, then Insidepost Autoposting for vkontakt, and follow the Instructions tab.
sections.changelog:
2.1.4

  • Plugin name is Insidepost Autoposting for vkontakt. vkontakt is named as a third-party service.

2.1.3

  • Requests to vkontakt go through the WordPress HTTP API.
  • Settings screen with an instruction tab, a send log, and extra text options.
  • Nonces and capability checks on admin actions. Settings are sanitized before they are stored.

2.0.3

  • Updated the vkontakt API version.

2.0.2

  • Store the wall post URL in the plugin log.
  • Fixed the token field.
  • Updated the codebase for newer WordPress versions.

2.0.1

  • Choose the text source.
  • Show the vkontakt post link in the editor.

2.0.0

  • Plugin rewrite.
